title: Autocorrelation
text: N 维数组的自相关，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Scaling} 指定输出的缩放；{Compute all non-negative lags} 指定在所有非负滞后上计算自相关、{Maximum non-negative lag (less than input length)} 指定最大正滞后、{Computation domain} 指定模块计算自相关的域、{Rounding mode} 指定舍入运算的方法、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 指定模块可以输出的最小值、{Output Maximum} 指定模块可以输出的最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 数据输入 vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 自相关输出 vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Compute all non-negative lags
params.values: 在所有非负滞后上计算自相关 on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum non-negative lag (less than input length)
params.values: 最大正滞后 1 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 0 and less than input length

params.name: Scaling
params.values: 输出的缩放 None (default) | Biased | Unbiased | Unity at zero-lag

params.name: Computation domain
params.values: 模块计算自相关的域 Time (default) | Frequency

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入运算的方法 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: 模块可以输出的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: 模块可以输出的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
